title: Quenched SLE Universality for Weakly Disordered FK–Ising Interfaces
main_claim: There is an eps_0>0 such that for every fixed 0<eps<eps_0, the critical FK–Ising Dobrushin interface with couplings J_e=1+eps*xi_e (xi_e iid fair signs) on filled square-lattice approximations of any bounded marked Jordan domain has quenched conditional law converging in environmental probability (bounded-Lipschitz metric on curves) to chordal SLE_{16/3}.

issues.location: sections/inputs.tex, Prop. bulk-input / prop:critical-input (imported from companion Q, Thm 6.2, Prop 8.2, Lemma 8.3)
issues.description: The whole argument rests on the companion paper Q: the bulk scale-transformation trajectory with X_k <= A sqrt(v_k) -> 0 (only about k^{-1/2}, not summable), identification h*=0, and the local FK barrier lemma. These were checked against Q's statements, which match, but Q's proofs were not re-audited here. This paper only needs X_k -> 0, and its boundary recurrence is built for that, so the dependence is stated consistently. Any gap in Q carries over.
issues.evidence: "Theorem~6.2 ... gives X_k<=A sqrt(v_k) and v_k<=(v_0^{-1}+ck)^{-1} ... These proofs ... do not require summability of X_k over k."

coverage: Read all of introduction, inputs, boundary (Lemma boundary-transfer and Corollary), polygon (exactness, boundary recurrence, completion), slits (chart, deletion, fibers, cover trapping, compact containment, fixed-test, shared-edge comparison, moving-test proof), the start of identification (bounded martingale tests), and the deterministic-subsequence, arm-bound, avoidability, curve-tightness and no-return parts of tightness. Checked by computation or hand: the boundary Pfaffian ratio 1-l+l/(1-l)=1+l^2/(1-l) with the cross-ratio identity 1-l=(x4-x1)(x3-x2)/((x3-x1)(x4-x2)), which gives the d^{-2} straight-side transfer; the l~1/d modulus scaling; the drift condition for g'^h (g-W)^{-h} with h=1/2, which forces kappa=16/3; the cap-change density and T(p); f(1-x)=1-f(x) and f~sqrt(x/2); the self-dual odds v_+v_-=2 giving v_e=sqrt2 e^{theta xi}; the factorization bound in the free-ray screening argument; and the flip-conjugacy argument that gives a common scalar for the ++ and +- constructions. Skimmed only: the macroscopic tip-approximation proof, the rest of pure.tex (the cover version of Chelkak–Smirnov and the primitive-parameter relation), and the tail of identification. Did not re-audit the companion papers Q or C.
sibling_notes: The family-223 board had entries for C (Conformal-Limits, no_gap partial), the below-one paper (no_gap partial) and the 1<=q<4 paper (gap_found in its Sec 7.3 norm-diagram/holomorphicity budget). This paper uses C only for the q=2 four-point normalization, the cap calculation and the martingale-identification strategy. For q=2 the pure four-point limit comes directly from Chelkak–Smirnov, so the q in [1,4) holomorphicity gap flagged for the sibling does not appear to affect it. The sibling's numeric check that C's formula matches Chelkak–Smirnov at q=2 supports the f(chi) used here. The main external dependency is Q (Quenched SLE3, a different family), which had no board entry.
